subQuests.subQuestName: Head to Speranza for a meal

160190101.text: Ahem... May I take your order?

160190102.text: Turns out I'm treating a friend today, so... I'd like to order the finest dish in the house.

160190103.text: Oh... I take it you're referring to our... secret menu?

160190104.text: That's right. Tell the chef to sharpen his knife... I'm expecting surgical precision.

160190106.text: Yeah, "The Hidden Hero." It's a novel my best friend Helka sent from Liyue. There's this chef, and he fights the bad guys with a kitchen knife! It's really cool.

160190107.text: It's her favorite part of the book. She's always nagging Linnea to act it out with her.

160190108.text: Psst! Linnea, do you think Chef Jurva could be a hero in disguise, too? He does chop vegetables super fast...

160190109.text: Ooh... I think it's definitely possible...

160190110.text: Not a chance, I'm afraid. Evening, everyone. What can I get you?

160190111.text: Why don't you choose for us? I'm treating a friend today. We're celebrating our success in the qualifiers.

160190112.text: Sure thing. I'll rustle up a few of my specialties, then. Won't be long!

160190115.text: I gotta go. Let's play again soon, Linnea!

160190116.text: You seem to get along really well with everyone here. Oh, that's right — didn't you say that this used to be your home?

160190117.text: Yes. After my parents departed, I came to live here with my friends in the Conch Gang.

160190120.text: Ah! I didn't mean... like that. They're still alive and well, they just don't live around here anymore.

160190121.text: Come to think of it, I haven't told you my story yet. I guess you'll have noticed the wings on my head by now? They're proof that I'm not human.

160190122.text: Yeah, Paimon noticed those! Are you comfortable telling us some more?

160190123.text: Sure. Well, it's a story that starts a long, long time ago.

160190124.text: When I was just a kid, my wings were barely noticeable. They looked just like two little cowlicks.

160190125.text: No one suspected there was anything unusual about me at first. Not even Mom and Dad — they were too busy to notice.

160190126.text: But I always had this strange feeling I couldn't explain... Like I knew that all these little ways I was different from my friends couldn't just be a coincidence.

160190127.text: Then, when I was a little bit older, I read this story in a book of folktales... It was about "changelings."

160190129.text: The story goes that some of the Snowland Fae will secretly switch their own child with a human baby, leaving their offspring to be raised by humans while taking the human child for themselves.

subQuests.subQuestName: Have a training match with Linnea

160190202.text: It's strange. When I was battling you, I couldn't seem to get into the zone. I had no way to predict your next move.

160190205.text: Hey, I'm curious — why does Aguara have a ribbon tied around his tail? And how did you two meet, anyway?

160190207.text: You briefly sum up the events from "Lost in the Woods" and how you came to be friends with Aguara.

160190209.text: ...Someday, I wanna go on an adventure of my own, show Lumi every corner of the world. There's gotta be countless stories out there waiting to be told.

160190212.text: But most importantly, we have to figure out who you are and where you came from. Then, we can track down others just like you.

160190213.text: Maybe then, you won't feel lonely anymore.

160190215.text: Ah! It's about time we all got some rest. Good training session, everyone!

160190216.text: I'll see you at the arena tomorrow! Oh, we'll have to draw lots again, won't we? Hopefully we don't end up facing each other this early in the competition...

160190217.text: Wait, no! Agh! Forget I said it! I should go before I jinx it!

160190219.text: See you tomorrow! Thanks for dinner!

160192601.text: Bleurgh! Waiter! Come here and taste this Wildberry Trail, then look me in the eye and tell me it's fit for human consumption!

160192602.text: It's much too sour and has a bitter aftertaste! I want my money back!

160192603.text: Please don't shout. I assure you, the berries we use are of the highest quality — "bitter" is out of the question.

160192604.text: I think you've had too much to drink. Time to settle up and leave.

160192605.text: Too much to drink!? I'm perfectly sober, thank you! Now, you'd better give me this meal on the house, otherwise—

160192607.text: Huh? Who the heck are you?

160192608.text: Oh, I'll tell you who the heck I am. The name's Arataki "Thanks-for-Waiting, Mucho-Apreciado" Itto!

160192609.text: Uhh... an oni... it's an oni!!!

160192610.text: Nice work, Itto. Keep this up, and we might just have to double your bonus at the end of the month.

160192611.text: Heh, don't you worry about a thing. As long as Itto's around, consider this establishment protected.

subQuests.subQuestName: Return to The Flagship to rest

160191001.text: The person in the room next door paces around restlessly all night. Despite the annoying pitter-patter of footsteps, you manage to drift off to sleep...

subQuests.subQuestName: Draw lots for the elimination round

160190401.text: Let's see, your next opponent is... Haniyyah. Huh, that name sounds familiar...

160190404.text: Ohhh, yeah! Paimon remembers now! She's been looking after our Fungi friends this whole time...

160190405.text: Who do you think she's gonna partner up with for the competition?

160190406.text: Come on, let's go say hello!

160190501.text: Welcome one and all! The Round of 16 is about to begin.

160190502.text: #Our contestants for this match are: {NICKNAME} and {M#his}{F#her} partner Aguara, versus Haniyyah and her partner, Fluffy the Flower King!

160190503.text: Hey, Golden Comet and Silver Companion! Good to see you again. This'll be our first proper rematch since the Nilotpala Cup...

160190504.text: I brought my old Sumpter Beast with me this time. Looks like you're partnering with a new companion too... Let's see who wins this time around!

160191202.text: Ah, what a shame... We were so close!

160191203.text: Even with a new partner, you're still as tough as they come... *sigh* This was some bad luck, running into you so early in the competition.

160191204.text: Well, since you defeated me, you'd better go all the way like in the Nilotpala Cup. I can handle losing — but only to a champion! So you go show them who's boss!

160191206.text: Alright! We're through to the quarter-finals! Let's go see who our next opponent is.

subQuests.subQuestName: Draw lots for the second elimination round

160190613.text: Let Paimon take a look — next up is... Mualani?

160190601.text: Whoa, so we have to fight that big koholasaur next? Aguara, we're counting on you!

160190606.text: Hey, Paimon noticed something when we were drawing lots. Most of the contestants have given their animal companion a cool title. Shall we come up with one for Aguara, too?

subQuests.subQuestName: Participate in the second elimination round
Participate in the second elimination round

160190701.text: Are you ready to ruuumble? Ladies and gentlemen, it's time for the quarterfinals!

160190702.text: After a fierce competition so far, we're left with the creme de la creme of the contestants. But who among them will advance to the semifinals? There's only one way to find out!

160190703.text: #Joining us to kick this round off, we have... {NICKNAME} and {M#his}{F#her} partner Aguara, versus Mualani and her partner Mamala!

160190706.text: That's the spirit! Now, let's get out there and show these Nod-Krai folks what the People of the Springs are all about!

160190801.text: #Mamala has lost the strength to fight on — {NICKNAME} and Aguara are the winners!

160190802.text: Seriously? There's no way I just lost...

160190803.text: Gotta hand it to you, Aguara... You are seriously strong for your age! That was incredible!

160190806.text: Hey, you're strong too, Mamala. That one was on me — I made too many bad calls. I'm sorry!

160190807.text: Keep it up, Aguara! I wanna see you take down even more opponents. You were the best little saurian out there today!

160190809.text: I'll leave you guys to it. Cheer up, Mamala! How about I take you for a tasty treat, huh?

160190811.text: Wow, that was a nail-biting match... Paimon's heart's still racing!

160190812.text: Anyway, Linnea will have finished her match by now, too, right? Let's go see how she did!

160190815.text: It sure is. Wanna take a guess who won?

160190816.text: Judging by the smile on your face, Paimon's pretty sure it was you.

160190817.text: Correct. I was about to go watch the other matches. Care to join me?

160190818.text: The next one's a pretty big deal. Someone called Celaeno versus the reigning champion, Jahoda.

160190819.text: Ooh, we have to watch that! Jahoda's a friend of ours, so we should be there to cheer her on.

160190820.text: Perfect. Well, stick around — it should be starting soon.

160190821.text: What the... Celaeno's companion is a Radiant Bladehorn!? Those things are extremely hostile... How did she manage to tame it?

160190822.text: Technically speaking, Radiant Bladehorns are classed as monsters... but they are beasts of the wild, and they're not exactly uncommon. It's not against the rules, but still... it's gonna be a really hard one to beat...

160190823.text: Go for it, Jahoda! You got this!

160190825.text: Ignorance really is bliss. But it won't last forever...

160190826.text: (So, Celaeno's her name. She was the one watching Linnea's last match, and there was something strangely hostile about her demeanor...)

160190827.text: (But Linnea doesn't seem to know who she is. She talked about her as if she's just another contestant.)

160190828.text: Do you think speed alone will stop me from catching you?

160190829.text: How about you run around and find out!

160190830.text: Reed Miller XIII, run that thing ragged and then go in for the kill!

160190834.text: Her reaction time is incredible! It's almost as if...

160190835.text: She can read her opponent's mind!

160190838.text: Thanks, that means a lot! Yeah, I think we performed pretty well out there. Not just Lumi — I was really in the zone today.

160190839.text: I dunno how to explain it, but... Sometimes, it feels like I can predict my opponent's next move. I know exactly what to do before I've even had the time to think.

160190840.text: (Linnea said something similar after her first match. Could it be a coincidence?)

160190842.text: He's trying to jump on your back, Haemus. Don't give him the chance.

160190843.text: Use your wind blades to slow him down.

160190845.text: He's too powerful! We've gotta go for a knockout blow!

160190846.text: Charge your lightning, Reed, then blast him with all you've got!

160190850.text: Tch... That was close. But the outcome is all that matters.

160190851.text: Reed Miller XIII has lost the strength to fight on — Celaeno and Haemus are the winners!

160190855.text: W—Wait! Who are you? And why do you...

160190858.text: I've been through this moment so many times in my head... Imagining you sharing the same pain I feel.

160190859.text: I thought it would bring me joy, but I guess not... You're better off with the life you have, Linnea. The less you know, the better.

160190860.text: Argh... My head... Don't go! Wait, I... I...

160190862.text: Wh—What happened? Why did Linnea faint?

160190863.text: We gotta find her somewhere to lie down. Quick, hurry!

160190864.text: What happened? Uh, uhhh... I'll go get Lauma!

160193301.text: She's breathing normally — no obstruction of the airways. She just needs a little peace and quiet.

160193302.text: Phew... That's a relief! Thanks, Lauma.

160193303.text: My pleasure. If she has any more trouble, just let me know.

160193305.text: Oh, Linnea... Please wake up soon...

160193307.text: (Lumi! Lumi! How strange — where could she be?)

160193308.text: (I wonder how long I was out for... Well, I'd better take a look outside.)

160190902.text: (Guess not... Huh? Is Dream-Me writing a diary?)

160190903.text: "My Adventurers' Guild salary alone will never be enough to finance a research vessel. It seems my only option is to take up adventuring full-time."

160190904.text: (A research vessel? Looks like Dream-Me is working hard toward my goal... But the cost is just astronomical. It could take a whole lifetime to save up for.)

160190906.text: "Day 5: Ran for my life with Lumi. Turns out I'm getting faster!"

160190907.text: "Day 20: Asked a merchant about prices. Ships cost a fortune! But I can worry about that later. Right now, it's time for a proper meal — I'm starving."

160190908.text: "Day 72: Found a huge abandoned treasure chest. Hehe, finders keepers!"

160190909.text: "Happy Adventure Anniversary to me! One year in... and still nowhere near rich enough to afford a ship."

160190910.text: "Almost got scammed! Note to self — secondhand ships aren't to be trusted. Good job I was wary and checked it over thoroughly before committing. You really do get what you pay for."

160190911.text: "Finally beat that pesky thing. Hoping the materials I gathered recently will fetch a good price..."

160190912.text: (The diary ends here. Hold on, is this..?)

160190913.text: (A deed for the purchase of a large ship, and I've signed it! Could it be...?)

subQuests.subQuestName: Enter the depths of the dream

160190301.text: (Lumi! There you are. I've been looking all over for you.)

160190302.text: (Come on, say something. Why do you look so anxious? Uh...)

160190303.text: Looks like our contestants and their partners are in position.

160190304.text: On the one side, we have Linnea and her partner Lumi, and on the other side, we have Celaeno and her partner Haemus! Buckle up folks — the semi-finals are about to begin!

160190306.text: (Wait, how is it the semifinals already!? Also, how did I even get here...? I don't remember a thing!)

160190307.text: (...Oh. I get it. I'm still dreaming.)

160190308.text: You can do it, old boss!

160190309.text: (Even if this is a dream, I can't let my supporters down. I'm gonna give this my all!)

160190310.text: (We're up, Lumi! Let's show them what we've got!)

160190312.text: What a spectacular duel! But Lumi has lost the strength to fight on... Meaning, Celaeno and Haemus have earned their place in the final!

160190313.text: (Huh? What's going on? They're saying I lost already?)

160190314.text: (This dream sucks! I wanna wake up, right now.)

160190315.text: (Hmm, I've heard that if you try really hard to open your eyes, you can force yourself awake. Nnngh!)

subQuests.subQuestName: Enter the depths of the dream
Enter the depths of the dream

160191501.text: (Lemme check the chart. Next stop, Guyun Stone Forest... That place is steeped in myths and stories. I've only ever seen it in picture books.)

160191502.text: (From there, it's on to Dragonspine... Wow, a snow-capped mountain! I've always wanted to visit, but never dared to.)

160192201.text: (What's this? ...Clearwater Jade? Pretty sure this can only be found in Chenyu Vale... It's so beautiful.)

160192202.text: (It looks like this ship has sailed to many places already. Makes sense — as soon as I buy my research vessel, I'll be off and away to voyage non-stop.)

160192204.text: You've been really down the last couple of days. What's up? You're not seasick, are you?

160192205.text: I've left your lunch by the door. Make sure to get some good rest once you've eaten.

160192302.text: (I feel so sore... and tired. Wait, but I thought I was dreaming? Why do I feel like this?)

160192303.text: (Is this some sort of lucid dream...? Whatever, I'd better take a look outside.)

160191601.text: (Clearwater Jade... Didn't I see this on the ship just now? Why is it in pieces...)

160191602.text: (And these books... How did they end up in this cave?)

subQuests.subQuestName: Investigate the source of the sound

160192001.text: (Lumi... Why do you look so sad?)

160192002.text: (Hey, hey, don't be scared. I'm right here by your side.)

160191701.text: (Wh—What happened? I thought I was on the ship...)

160191705.text: (I—It's just a dream though... right? Come on, get a grip, Linnea. It's not real. None of this is real...)

subQuests.subQuestName: Enter the depths of the dream

160191801.text: "It's been many long years since the Golden Beagle sank."

160191802.text: (The diary again... How long is this terrible dream going to last?)

160191803.text: "I'd love to say I'm over it now, but the truth is it still gets me down sometimes. It's like there's a heavy stone that's blocking up my heart, constantly weighing me down."

160191804.text: "Maybe a walk in the courtyard will take my mind off things. Besides, my sister should be here soon. I can wait for her outside."

160191905.text: Over here. Did you get my letter, Linnea?

160191906.text: I'm so sorry to be the bearer of bad news. Come back to the tundra with me, so we can be with Mom and Dad one last time.

160191909.text: This is the natural circle of life. We don't live that much longer than humans — this day was always going to come.

160191910.text: I... I can't pretend I'm not sad.

160191911.text: But at the same time... I wonder how an ordinary person would react to hearing this news? At the very least, they wouldn't have to endure this horrid feeling of having tears they're unable to shed.

160191912.text: After all... we've already seen how all of this would unfold, long before it ever came to pass.

160191913.text: Remember? When you passed out during that competition? You saw it all as you lay there unconscious. <color=#37FFFF>At the time, you thought it was just a dream.</color>

160191915.text: (No.... No, no, no... This can't be true...)

160191916.text: I understand how you feel. One moment, you're gazing into the future from the past, the next, you're there, looking back at where it all began... When these two perspectives collide, how can the journey not feel like a dream?

160191917.text: Time flies. One day, we too will grow old. Is it even possible to live a life without regrets?

160191918.text: "A long, long time ago, my friends and I talked about our dreams."

160191919.text: "Mine was to buy a research vessel and explore the mysteries of the world. Then, when too old for a life of adventure, I'd combine everything I'd learned into an illustrated atlas of nature."

160191920.text: "My entire life is recorded in these pages. Maybe one day, a long, long time from now, someone will open them and see that there are sections on the formation and evolution of certain creatures and environments that remain blank."

160191921.text: "Whoever you are, I entrust the task of filling those blank pages to you. The end of my time grows near, and I can no longer travel very far."

subQuests.subQuestName: Walk towards the end of everything

160192101.text: (This feels like an illusion, yet at the same time, so real...)

160192102.text: (The end of life... So this is what death feels like.)

160192103.text: (I still feel some faint sensations in my stiffening body, but I... I can't so much as move a finger. As the warmth flows out of me, I feel no pain, just the emptiness that remains after everything else has slipped away...)

160192104.text: (So it wasn't a dream after all... It's all...)

160192403.text: A—Are you sure that's a good idea? A head-on collision between Aguara and a Sumpter Beast?

160192405.text: ...Look at that, right into orbit. Nice work, Fluffy!

160193001.text: You're even tougher than last time!

160193002.text: But you know what? Sumpter Beasts are renowned for their endurance. It's their refusal to give up that allows them to traverse huge rainforests and deserts, one step at a time.

160193003.text: And when they charge full speed... Haha, they kick up enough dust to blot out the sky.

160193004.text: Send 'em flying, Fluffy the Flower King!

160191104.text: Ugh... Looks like this isn't gonna work.

160191105.text: Contestants, please have your animal companions return to the arena immediately, or you'll both be disqualified!

160191302.text: Taking it head-on, huh? You shoulda run!

160191303.text: Sorry, but in terms of brute strength, a young tepetlisaur is no match for an adult koholasaur.

160191304.text: Don't try to be a hero next time!

160191401.text: I—I can't believe it... My glorious journey ended at the first step...

160191402.text: It's your own fault for not reading the rules...

160191404.text: Ushi, Crimson Staff... Are you guys tryin' to cheer me up? Well, don't you worry! We'll come back stronger than ever next time, and I'll lead us to a glorious victory, fair and square!

160191405.text: Anyway, seeing as we came all this way, I think a little sightseeing is in order! Hahaha, let's go get ourselves a taste of Krod-Krai culture!

160191407.text: Do you actually have any Mora left?

160191409.text: Ahem... Hey, Lavender Melon! I've got a little, uh, proposition for ya—

160191410.text: No way! If you want Mora, go earn it like everyone else!

160191412.text: Pffft, fine, don't lend me anything then! Watch me, I'll figure something out. This is a small pond — and Arataki Itto is the biggest fish around!

160192705.text: You took advantage of Mamala's blind spot... Not bad!

160192802.text: Saw that one coming a mile away!

160192803.text: Tepetlisaurs might have the advantage on land, but it's a different story in the water.

160192901.text: What a tough cookie! I thought this'd be way easier... Your little saurian doesn't play around!

160192902.text: Alright, get up close and let's settle this!

160192903.text: Jump, Mamala! Get out of the water!

160192904.text: (From what I remember, Mamala's left eye is covered by an eyepatch. That might be an opening...)

160199901.text: Whew... Let's head back to The Flagship and get some sleep. Paimon's eyes are starting to droop!

160199902.text: Morning... Ah! Is that the time!? The draw's about to start! Come on, we gotta get moving!
